outline: The aim of this course is to provide a detail understanding of the standards of WLANs, with emphasis on the techniques of standard reading. The standards of WLANs, including IEEE 802.11a, IEEE 802.11g, and IEEE 802.11e are discussed. Both MAC layer and PHY layer techniques are covered. Topics include access technology, framed format, network management, channel coding, and OFDM modulation.
schedule:
MAC layer
DCF (CSMA/CA protocol and RTS/CTS mechanism) (1 month)
PCF (1 week)
MAC Frame structure (2 week)
PHY layer
Interleaving and Convolution code (encoding and decoding) (3 week)
OFDM modulation (1 month)
Physical layer packet structure (1 month)
